collected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when data was collected

users_present.description: Whether the provider has any users the user_security percentages count. When false, those percentages are null

user_count.description: Accounts that can sign in. The user_security percentages and policy.mfa_required_coverage_pct count these

mfa_user_count.description: Users with any MFA factor enrolled

phishing_resistant_user_count.description: Users with phishing-resistant MFA (WebAuthn or FIDO2) enrolled

inactive_user_count.description: Users inactive for 90 days or more

password_policy_noncompliant_user_count.description: Users whose passwords do not meet current password policy requirements

mfa_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of users with any MFA factor enrolled

mfa_phishing_resistant_pct.description: Percentage of users with phishing-resistant MFA (WebAuthn/FIDO2)

inactive_pct.description: Percentage of users inactive for 90+ days

locked_out_pct.description: Percentage of users currently locked out

weak_password_pct.description: Percentage of users with weak passwords

password_policy_noncompliant_pct.description: Percentage of users whose passwords do not meet current password policy requirements

user_security.description: Percentages of the provider's users with MFA, with phishing-resistant MFA, inactive, locked out, and with weak or noncompliant passwords.

apps_present.description: Whether the provider has any applications the app_security percentages count. When false, those percentages are null

sso_app_count.description: Applications using federated SSO (SAML or OIDC)

sso_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of applications using federated SSO (SAML/OIDC)

provisioning_enabled_pct.description: Percentage of applications with automated provisioning

deprovisioning_enabled_pct.description: Percentage of applications with automated deprovisioning

authorized_third_party_apps_count.description: Count of authorized third-party applications or OAuth integrations

app_security.description: How the provider's apps sign users in and provision them, and how many third-party apps users have authorized.

privileged_users_present.description: Whether the provider has any users with privileged administrative access. When false, the privileged percentages are null

privileged_users_count.description: Count of users with privileged administrative access

super_admin_count.description: Count of highest-privilege administrative accounts (for example Global Admin or Super Admin)

privileged_mfa_user_count.description: Privileged users with MFA enabled or enforced

privileged_mfa_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of privileged users with MFA enabled or enforced

privileged_phishing_resistant_pct.description: Percentage of privileged users with phishing-resistant MFA

standing_privileged_users_present.description: Whether any user holds standing privileged access, as standing_privileged_users_count defines it

standing_privileged_users_count.description: Count of users with standing privileged access instead of just-in-time or eligible access

privileged_access.description: Counts of privileged users and the share of them with MFA and with phishing-resistant MFA.

accounts_present.description: Whether the provider has any accounts, in any state. When false, the lifecycle percentages are null

account_count.description: Accounts in every state, including suspended and archived accounts. The lifecycle percentages count these

suspended_account_count.description: Accounts in a suspended or disabled state

archived_account_count.description: Accounts in an archived, retained, or soft-deleted state

suspended_pct.description: Percentage of accounts in suspended or disabled state

archived_pct.description: Percentage of accounts in archived, retained, or soft-deleted state

lifecycle.description: Percentages of users suspended and archived.

mfa_required.description: Whether the tenant enforces MFA for all covered users

mfa_required_user_count.description: Users covered by policies that require MFA, out of user_security.user_count

mfa_required_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of users covered by policies that require MFA

session_lifetime_max_min.description: Maximum session lifetime across all policies (minutes)

idle_timeout_max_min.description: Maximum idle timeout across all policies (minutes)

legacy_auth_blocked.description: Whether legacy authentication protocols are blocked

phishing_resistant_required_for_privileg.description: Whether phishing-resistant authentication is required for privileged users

policy.description: Sign-in policy settings: MFA requirements, session limits, and legacy authentication.

managed_device_required.description: Whether access to core corporate resources requires a managed or compliant device

managed_device_required_for_admins.description: Whether privileged access requires a managed or compliant device

device_access.description: Whether sign-in policies require a managed device, for all users and for administrators.
